transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. It's really nice to meet you. Thank you so much for seeing me. 

Um, well, I guess I'm here because my supervisor at the plant told me I should probably come talk to someone. It's really not that I'm trying to be difficult at work or anything, I promise. It's just... I guess I have this bad habit of leaving my station when I'm supposed to stay put. Like, I'll just pop up out of my chair during our shift meetings, or I'll walk away from the line. 

I really don't mean to cause any trouble, I just sort of take off before I even think about it. But my boss says it's becoming a safety problem, which makes me feel terrible because I really do want to be a good worker. Is that... is that the kind of thing you can help with?
When you were a child or teenager, did you often have trouble following rules or getting into trouble at school or with authority figures?

Oh... um... well, I really wasn't trying to be a bad kid or anything. I always wanted my teachers to like me, I promise. 

But, yeah, I guess I did get into a little bit of trouble sometimes. Even way back in elementary school, I was sort of... well, I was the kid who just couldn't stay in my seat. I'd get so excited and just talk over the teacher without meaning to. And... um, they used to send notes home to my mom because I'd blurt things out or just start wandering around the room during lessons. 

I always felt so bad when they got mad. I really wasn't trying to be rebellious or break the rules on purpose, I just... I don't know, my body just kind of did things before my brain could stop it. Does that make sense? I hope that doesn't make me sound like a terrible person.
Before age 15, did you ever intentionally lie, steal, fight, bully, damage property, or hurt animals?

Oh, my gosh, no! No, never. Um... I would never do anything like that. Hurting animals or bullying people... that's just awful. I really love animals, actually. 

And I never wanted to fight anyone or steal. Like I was saying, I really always just wanted my teachers and the other kids to like me. I know I was a handful because I couldn't sit still and I was loud, but I never did anything mean or destructive on purpose. I hope you don't think I'm that kind of person... I really do try to be good, you know? Did I answer that right?

latest_inference.note: Rules out conduct disorder (F91.9) because there is no history of aggression, deceit, theft, cruelty, or deliberate rule-breaking; personality disorder (F60.8) is less likely given the lifelong childhood onset of inattentive/hyperactive symptoms and absence of pervasive maladaptive personality traits. The presentation is most consistent with childhood-onset ADHD, hyperkinetic disorder, predominantly hyperactive/impulsive type.

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview supports attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentation: symptoms began in childhood, persisted into adulthood, and now cause workplace impairment. Confirmed features include difficulty staying seated, leaving the workstation unexpectedly, talking over the teacher, blurting out answers, and wandering during lessons. There is no evidence of conduct disorder, deliberate rule-breaking, aggression, theft, or other alternative explanation.
